Title: Add queued accepts, reliable completion, and useful route tracking
Problem / Request: Field reconciliation found 11 completed Uber trips and one cancellation. Add a deterministic lifecycle with queued accepts, reliable completion, reservation support, observed/effective timestamps, foreground route tracking, and reconciliation safeguards.
Acceptance Criteria: PR #6 must preserve active and queued trip state when ending a shift, enforce lifecycle idempotency, send route-derived miles at drop-off, support explicit queued-trip cancellation, show current/next-trip context, include deterministic test-mode queue and reservation scenarios, and retain complete task metadata. GitHub Actions must pass. No merge or deployment occurs automatically.
